rationale: This Raad van State decision concerns municipal enforcement (last onder dwangsom) under Articles 6 and 13 of the Dutch Soil Protection Act (Wet bodembescherming) requiring a soil investigation (inventariserend bodemonderzoek) and soil remediation after an agricultural enterprise discharged crop protection chemicals directly onto soil (geloosd op de bodem / bodemlozingen). The dispute governs terrestrial soil contamination rather than water law, water resources, or water/sanitation services.
